data.one_liner: Parses JSON output from the Dart test runner into structured test report objects.
data.what_it_does: The testreport package processes JSON event streams produced by the Dart test runner when run with `--reporter json`. It aggregates individual suite, group, and test events into an interpreted Report object. This structured model provides easy programmatic access to test counts, durations, and pass/fail statuses.
use_when: Building custom CI/CD tooling or dashboards to parse Dart test output.
Converting Dart test runner JSON events into structured summaries, badges, or other report formats.
avoid_when: You only need standard human-readable terminal output from tests.
You are running integration or golden tests inside an application without parsing runner events.
strengths: Zero external dependencies, keeping installations lightweight.
Works across all Dart platforms with null safety support.
Simplifies aggregating complex streaming test runner JSON events into structured reports.
weaknesses: README lacks concrete Dart code examples showing how to instantiate and call the Processor API.
Specialized utility strictly limited to handling Dart test runner JSON output.
